spanish: Entonces llamarás, y Jehová responderá; clamarás, y dirá: Heme aquí; si quitas de en medio de ti yugo, enviar dedo y hablar iniquidad,

findings.issue: infinitives rendered as bare verbs instead of nominal phrases; omits required structure of 'sending finger' and 'speaking iniquity' as objects of removal
word order and article omission distort 'remove yoke from your midst'
